statement: Every refusal the server can answer a write with, the server's own detail for it, what the pane promises to keep, and the walk check or pytest node that proves both halves. A write that does not read the status is a finding, and so is a refusal whose reason the UI invented.

refusals.when: the Host header is not in STUDIO_ALLOWED_HOSTS
refusals.detail: Host is not permitted; configure STUDIO_ALLOWED_HOSTS explicitly.
refusals.reachable: server-only: a browser that reached the page passed this check already
refusals.kept: nothing was read or written; the page is not this host
refusals.contract: not drawn in a pane - the request never reached a handler, and the browser that could see it is not on an allowed host

refusals.when: the bearer token is missing or wrong
refusals.reachable: real: the walk swaps the browser's token for a wrong one
refusals.kept: the pane keeps its state and the reader's text; nothing was sent
refusals.contract: error presentation naming 401, the boundary's detail as the cause, a Kept: line, and a 'Re-enter the token' action that keeps the pane

proof.check: a wrong token is reported as 401 with the boundary's own detail and a way to re-enter it

refusals.when: a stream is refused before it opens (/api/chat/stream and the other SSE routes)
refusals.reachable: real: the walk sends from a browser whose token is wrong
refusals.kept: the message, the transcript and the partial reply are kept
refusals.contract: the pane states the server's reason instead of `HTTP 401`

proof.check: a refused chat stream shows the server's reason, not "HTTP 401"

refusals.when: a state-changing request carries a cross-origin Origin header
refusals.reachable: injected: a page cannot forge Origin, so the walk replaces the response at the network layer with this text
refusals.kept: the spawn dialog stays open with the request text; the round is not created
refusals.contract: error presentation naming 403 with the server's detail, and the reader's text still in the control

proof.check: an injected cross-origin 403 on the Council spawn keeps the modal open with the reader's text

refusals.when: a worktree apply is asked of a session whose policy is read-only 'plan'
refusals.detail: Cannot apply worktree changes while session policy is read-only 'plan'.
refusals.reachable: real: the walk creates a plan-policy session and presses Apply
refusals.kept: the session, its worktree and the main workspace are unchanged; the diff stays open
refusals.contract: the refusal is drawn inside the diff dialog where the button is, and nothing claims the apply happened

proof.check: a read-only session's refused apply is drawn with the server's own reason, not as "Applied!"

refusals.when: an approval decision carries a session id that did not raise the request
refusals.detail: Approval is scoped to its originating session; session_id must match.
refusals.reachable: server-only: the pane sends its own session id, so a browser cannot make this without forging the body
refusals.kept: the pending approval is still pending and no decision was recorded
refusals.contract: not drawn: the pane cannot produce the condition, and the approval card's preflight rejects a stale slot before it posts

refusals.when: the session or artifact the write names is no longer on the server
refusals.source: app.py get_harness_session_db -> KeyError -> 404 in apply, compact, patch, delete
refusals.reachable: real: the walk deletes a session underneath the open pane and presses Compact
refusals.kept: the pane keeps what it had; the server's message names what is gone
refusals.contract: recovery presentation naming 404, the server's message as the cause, and a Reload from the server action

proof.check: a compact on a session the server no longer has says 404 and keeps the reader's place

refusals.when: an approval id is decided twice, or a worktree apply conflicts
refusals.reachable: server-only for the approval (the card disables itself); the apply conflict is a state the walk does not manufacture
refusals.kept: the first decision stands; the second changed nothing
refusals.contract: recovery presentation naming 409 with the server's detail and a Reload from the server action

refusals.when: the request body is over STUDIO_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
refusals.detail: Request body exceeds the configured size limit.
refusals.reachable: injected: the walk replaces the response with this text rather than sending megabytes
refusals.kept: the pane and the session are unchanged; the request was not partially applied
refusals.contract: recovery presentation naming 413 and the server's detail, and no success toast

proof.check: an injected 413 on compaction is drawn as over the size limit, not as "Compaction checked"

refusals.when: the per-minute window for an expensive route is full
refusals.detail: Rate limit exceeded for expensive workflow requests.
refusals.source: app.py security_boundary (rate window) with a Retry-After header
refusals.reachable: real: the walk fills the window with cheap 400s and then sends
refusals.kept: the message and the transcript are kept; nothing was sent
refusals.contract: the pane states the server's Retry-After as a countdown, and the Retry control is disabled while the window is closed

proof.check: a full rate window is reported with the server's Retry-After as a countdown

refusals.when: no token is configured, so the boundary cannot authenticate anything
refusals.detail: Authentication is unavailable; configure a token and restart Studio.
refusals.reachable: injected: the demo always configures a token, so the walk replaces the response with this text
refusals.kept: nothing was written; the server needs an operator, not a retry
refusals.contract: a presentation naming 503 with the server's detail; no retry that would fail the same way

proof.check: an injected 503 is drawn as an error with the server's own detail

refusals.when: a snapshot or apply cannot write because the disk is full
refusals.reachable: injected: the walk replaces the response with a disk-full detail
refusals.kept: the workspace and the session are unchanged; the diff stays open
refusals.contract: recovery presentation naming 507 with the server's detail and a Reload action

proof.check: an injected 507 says the server has no room to write and is drawn as a recovery
